A zesty classic.

meals · serves 8 · draft

## Method

- 200 g self-raising flour
- 3 large eggs
- 1.5 tsp baking powder
- 2 tin chopped tomatoes (400 g)
- 0.5 cup milk (warmed, 120ml)
- Salt

1. Heat the oven to 180C.
2. Beat the eggs and sugar. then fold in the flour.
3. Bake for 40 minutes.

## Drizzle

- 100 g icing sugar
- juice of 2 lemons

Keeps 3 days.

## Method

- 250 g spaghetti
- 2 clove garlic (minced)
- 3-4 tbsp olive oil

1. Boil the pasta in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain well.
2. Fry the garlic in the oil.
3. Toss together and serve.
